title: Ufupisho (Theme 7: Kuhudumia jamii shuleni)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child explains a summary, picks the main point of each paragraph and writes them in order in his own words without losing the meaning.

floor.prerequisite: Finds the main idea of a paragraph.
floor.question: Wazo kuu la aya hii ni?

representations: colours for main points and examples
steps: Mark the main point of each paragraph.

board.say: Wazo kuu la aya hii ni lipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes the main point of each paragraph in order.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ufupisho ni nini?" Kwa nini "kunakili habari yote" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ufupisho ni kutoa habari kuu bila kupoteza maana.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ufupisho unapaswa kuwa vipi?" Kwa nini "upoteze maana ya habari" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Habari kuu ya aya ni ipi?" Kwa nini "mfano mdogo uliotolewa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Habari kuu ni wazo kuu la aya nzima.

misconceptions.ask: Hoja hii iko aya gani ya kifungu?
misconceptions.repair: Panga hoja za ufupisho kama zilivyo katika kifungu.

checks.question: Ufupisho ni nini?
checks.answer: kutoa habari kuu kwa ufupi bila kupoteza maana
